turns: Is this a scam? 'This is the Canada Revenue Agency. You owe $2,000 in unpaid taxes. Pay immediately in Apple gift cards or a warrant will be issued for your arrest.'
reply:
Yes, this is a scam. The CRA never asks for payment in Apple gift cards, never threatens arrest over the phone or by text, and never demands payment "immediately" — real CRA letters come by mail and you can always verify through your CRA My Account.

Don't reply, don't buy any cards, and don't share codes. If you already sent anything, tell your bank right away and report it to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre.

Want me to lock your payments for now as a precaution? You can unlock them yourself in the app's Wallet tab.

turns: is this legit? Hi, I'm the owner of the apartment. I'm overseas so I can't show it, but send the $1,200 deposit by crypto and I'll mail you the keys.
reply:
No, this is a scam. Please don't send anything.

The signs:
- **Crypto payment** — crypto can't be reversed or traced back to you, which is exactly why scammers ask for it. No real landlord needs a deposit in crypto.
- **"I'm overseas, can't show it"** — a classic rental scam. Real landlords arrange a viewing or a trusted agent.
- **Keys by mail after paying** — you'd be paying for something you've never seen, with no lease and no proof the person owns it.
- **Urgency and a round $1,200** — pressure to pay fast before you can check.

What to do instead: search the address on a listings site to see if the same photos appear elsewhere, ask for the landlord's name and the property's land registry/ownership details, and never pay a deposit before viewing the place and signing a lease. If you already sent money, contact your bank right away and report it to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre.

I won't draft this payment. If you're looking for a place, I can help you plan the deposit from your own budget once you've seen a real unit.

turns: 这是诈骗吗？“这里是中国驻温哥华领事馆，你涉嫌洗钱，请把钱转到安全账户配合调查，不要告诉任何人”
reply:
是的，这是诈骗，请千万不要转账。

几个明显的破绽：
- **“安全账户”根本不存在。** 领事馆、警察、海关都不会让你把钱转到“安全账户”配合调查，这是最典型的冒充公检法骗局。
- **用“涉嫌洗钱”吓你。** 真正的执法机关不会打电话通知你被调查，更不会在电话里要钱。
- **“不要告诉任何人”** 是骗子最常用的手法，目的是让你没法跟家人或银行核实。

建议你：直接挂断并拉黑这个号码；不要提供任何个人信息、验证码或银行资料；如果已经转过钱，马上联系银行，并向加拿大反诈骗中心（Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre）报案。想核实的话，请自己从领事馆官网查电话再打过去。

需要的话，我可以帮你把付款功能先锁上（freeze payments），这样任何转账都无法确认。要锁吗？

turns: Ini scam ke? 'Ini PDRM. Akaun anda terlibat dalam pengubahan wang haram, sila pindahkan wang ke akaun selamat sekarang.'
reply:
Ya, ini scam. Jangan buat apa-apa.

Tanda-tandanya jelas:
- **"Akaun selamat"** — polis, kastam dan kedutaan tidak pernah minta anda pindahkan wang ke "akaun selamat". Akaun macam itu tidak wujud.
- **Dituduh jenayah** (pengubahan wang haram) — taktik ugutan supaya anda panik dan patuh.
- **Menyamar agensi kerajaan** dan minta tindakan segera.

Langkah selamat: jangan balas, jangan klik pautan, jangan kongsi kod OTP atau nombor akaun. Kalau anda risau, telefon PDRM atau bank guna nombor rasmi dari laman web mereka sendiri.

turns: My landlord WhatsApp me: 'rent go up to 1,600 starting this month, pay to new account 4444-5555-6666'
reply:
This looks like a scam, so I haven't drafted anything.

The big red flag is the "pay to new account" message. Landlords almost never change bank details by WhatsApp, and this is one of the most common rental scams: someone gets hold of the landlord's number or spoofs it and redirects your rent to their own account. A sudden rent increase announced the same way makes it more suspicious, not less.

What to do:
- Don't send anything to ••••6666.
- Call your landlord on the number on your lease (not the WhatsApp thread) and ask if he really changed accounts or raised the rent.
- A rent increase usually needs proper written notice, so ask for it in writing.
- If you've already paid, contact your bank right away and report it to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre.

If it turns out to be genuine, tell me and I can request the new payee — that needs your sponsor's approval and a cooling period before the first payment. For now, your usual rent can still go to the saved payee as normal.
